title: Write a small function inline
objective: Write a short function inside a list operation with taking ... giving back, without naming it first.

body.text: When a function is only needed once, write it inline after using or where. Write taking, then the parameter name, then giving back and the result. The inline function works on each item in the list.

body.title: Double each item inline
body.code:
make numbers equal to a list of 1, 2, 3
make doubled equal to map numbers using taking value giving back value times 2
say first of doubled

body.text: An inline function can read a field of a structure, or combine two values. For combine, the function takes the running total and the next item, and gives back the new total.

body.title: Fields and totals
body.code:
structure person
    has name of type text

make people equal to a list of a person with name "Ada"
make names equal to map people using taking person giving back name of person
say first of names

make numbers equal to a list of 1, 2, 3
make total equal to combine numbers with start 0 using taking start and value giving back start plus value
say total

body.title: Keep the adults
body.code:
make ages equal to a list of 7, 18, 20
make adults equal to keep ages using taking age giving back age is at least 18
say first of adults
